name: Kaita (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kaita town emblem in white: a stylised device of two facing curved strokes crossed by diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kaita, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in July 1968.

features.role: Kaita town emblem — a stylised device of two facing curved strokes crossed by diagonal strokes
